rationale: itnet_v3-claude-agentic: itnet_k=3, unet_c=16, alpha_init=0.0037, lr=0.0001, epochs=6, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=579, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=660, seed=42, rationale=iter-6 (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol). BASE_ITER=5 (the BEST: c16/ep9/train_n=400, hr 0.328842). ONE KNOB: train_n 400 -> 579 (THE LAST DATA = full 579-slice Wagner train pool; itnet_v3 used the LEAST data of the 3 climbers -- champion dual_domain_supervised went to 579/full at hr 0.3994, uswin to 480). epochs traded DOWN 9 -> 6 to (a) hold total gradient steps near PARITY with iter-5 (579*6=3474 ~= 400*9=3600) so any hr change isolates DATA COVERAGE not extra optimization, and (b) fit the HARD 20-min train+score wall. All else = iter-5 exactly (itnet_k=3, unet_c=16, alpha_init=0.0037, lr=1e-4, val_n=214, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) itnet_v3 trajectory: iter-1 ep8/tn200 hr 0.268409 (737.85s); iter-2 ep14/tn200 hr 0.310054 (1010.07s); iter-3 ep18/tn200 hr 0.312282 (1072.94s, epochs PLATEAUED +0.0022); iter-4 ep9/c24/tn200 hr 0.295576 (834.0s, capacity REGRESSED -> revert c16); iter-5 BEST ep9/c16/tn400 hr 0.328842 / SSIM 0.915763 / PSNR 37.54 / RMSE 0.000664 (1006.81s=16.78min, params 3.699M, ~193s of the 1200s budget UNSPENT). The DATA lever delivered the largest single gain (tn200->400 = +0.0165). (2) LIMITER = DATA COVERAGE: itnet_v3 loads a FIXED stratified subset ONCE (load_val_split split=train n=train_n) and merely reshuffles it (torch.randperm) every epoch -- NO RotatingSubsetDataset -- so train_n=400 means the net has only EVER seen 400 of the 579-slice pool (69%). The full pool is 579 slices across 3 ps-groups (154@0.66192, 98@0.73979, 327@0.77873). epochs plateaued (iter-3), capacity regressed (iter-4); the ONE untried within-budget lever is the LAST 30% of data: train_n 400 -> 579 (full). Validated feasible: dual_domain_supervised reached the full pool at c16 within the same 20-min wall (measured 106.3 s/epoch). (3) ONE KNOB: train_n 400 -> 579 (full pool); epochs traded 9 -> 6 to hold grad-step parity (~3474 vs 3600) AND fit the wall. (4) HYPOTHESIS: filling the last 30% of the train pool (400 -> 579, full coverage) lifts hr ABOVE the iter-5 best 0.328842, because itnet_v3 is the END-TO-END unrolled variant (real learnable denoiser trained against the recon objective, so it genuinely benefits from data coverage) and DATA was its strongest confirmed lever (+0.0165 at 200->400) while it used the LEAST data of the 3 climbers. FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr <= 0.328842 at train_n=579/ep6 (grad steps held ~3500), itnet_v3 is at its budget-constrained ceiling (~0.329) with ALL three levers (epochs, capacity, data) exhausted -> it stays #3 on the Mayo board; file the ceiling verdict. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min = 1200s train+score): from iter-5's tn400 point per-epoch 68.9s @ tn400 = 0.1723 s/slice, fixed 481s (data load + per-sample-ps projector cache + 214-slice per-sample val + figure + startup). Per-epoch scales LINEARLY with train_n (bs=1 -> train_n steps/epoch), so tn579 -> per-epoch 99.7s. At epochs=6: 481 + 6*99.7 = 1079s = 18.0 min < 1200s with ~121s headroom (conservative 106.3 s/epoch cross-check from dual_domain_supervised tn579: 481 + 6*106.3 = 1119s = 18.7 min, still inside). epochs=7 -> 19.6 min (tight AND breaks parity), so epochs=6 is the parity-preserving choice. Train alone at ep6 = 6*99.7 = 598s < max_train_s=660 backstop, so the backstop does not truncate (checks between epochs; only fences runaway slowdown) and a finite recon + 214-slice val + figure always land inside the 30-min sbatch wall. val stays ALL 214 L277 slices, 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; no fov= override). grad_clip=1.0 retained (mandatory: the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint inside dc_step overflows otherwise). HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps FBP init + per-sample itnet.projector swap for the k=3 DC steps, bg_target=truth. (6) do NOT return control mid-campaign. Predicted iter-6 hr: 0.33-0.34 if data-coverage-limited hypothesis holds; <=0.3288 falsifies -> budget-constrained ceiling, all levers exhausted, stays #3.
